title: An elementary approach to delta and gamma hedging, and the Black--Scholes PDE
summary: We show how the robustness of gamma hedging can be understood just using the concepts of $p^{th}$ variation along a partition sequence and Taylor's theorem. There is no need to define an integral or proving a version of Itô's lemma. The same approach allows classical results on delta-hedging to be proved without defining an integral and without the need to define the concept of self-financing in continuous time. We show that the approach can also be applied to barrier options and Asian options. Finally, we extend the framework to path-dependent derivatives. We introduce a Gubinelli-type…
